name: Lo-Fi House
about: Lo-fi house is the hissy, tape-saturated strain of house that surfaced on YouTube and Bandcamp around 2016, when DJ Seinfeld, Ross from Friends, Mall Grab and DJ Boring put degraded, VHS-grade deep house in front of a new audience. Its sound is cheap by design: sampled drum breaks under a wash of tape noise, washed-out chords, pitched vocal snippets and a mix that seems to come through a wall. The roots are older, in Moodymann and Theo Parrish's dusty Detroit records, Omar-S, Legowelt and the Vancouver labels Mood Hut and 1080p. The backlash came quickly, but the main names grew into real album artists, and the aesthetic has become one of house music's default settings.

albums.title: Silentintroduction
albums.why: Kenny Dixon Jr.'s Planet E debut, sampled from Chic and recorded rough, is the dusty deep house record every lo-fi producer is imitating.

albums.title: First Floor
albums.why: Parrish's debut set hissy, half-speed jazz and soul loops against a kick that never quite lands on the grid; the lo-fi house source text.

albums.title: Mahogany Brown
albums.why: Longer and more song-like than the debut, with Sunday Morning and Tribute!; Detroit house at its most intimate and unpolished.

albums.title: Parallel Dimensions
albums.why: A wider, stranger record than First Floor, with Summertime Is Here; Parrish's drums are loose and the mix is dust on purpose.

albums.title: Just Ask the Lonely
albums.why: FXHE's first album is raw Detroit machine house with the hiss left in, and it taught a generation that cheap gear was not a problem.

albums.title: Hazyville
albums.why: Darren Cunningham's debut buried house grooves under fog and tape wobble, the London precedent for lo-fi house's blurred surfaces.

albums.title: The Paranormal Soul
albums.why: Danny Wolfers' Clone album is dusty, emotional Dutch house made on old hardware; its warmth is the template for the YouTube wave.

albums.title: Thank You for Letting Me Be Myself
albums.why: Omar-S's most complete album, with Its Money in the D and Rewind; house that sounds recorded in a basement because it was.

albums.title: Body Pill
albums.why: Naples' debut album drifts between hazy house and ambient on Four Tet's Text label, and it remains his most quietly loved record.

albums.title: Beaubien Dream
albums.why: The 1080p release that showed how melodic and warm the Vancouver tape-house sound could be; a small record that travelled a long way.

albums.title: Dark Bliss
albums.why: Lustwerk's first full album puts his murmured rap-sung vocals over smoky, lo-fi deep house; nobody else sounds quite like it.

albums.title: Dulce Compañia
albums.why: Brian Piñeyro's deep reggaeton debut is adjacent rather than central, but its hissy drums and melancholy chords belong to the same moment.

albums.title: Time Spent Away From U
albums.why: The Swedish producer behind U made the lo-fi house album that proved the style could sustain a full-length: breakup house, warm and sad.

albums.title: Family Portrait
albums.why: Felix Clary Weatherall's Brainfeeder debut is built from his parents' old sound-system tapes, and it is the richest lo-fi house album.

albums.title: Information
albums.why: The Ghostly album sharpens the blurry formula with more bass and sharper hooks; Cig Angel is the keeper.

albums.title: Mirrors
albums.why: Cleaner and more Ninja Tune than the debut, with Teary Eyed Crackdown; the lo-fi producer grown into a pop-house songwriter.

albums.title: Tread
albums.why: Built with his own software, Tread is more intricate and less hazy than Family Portrait; the lo-fi aesthetic turned into a method.

albums.title: Opening the Door
albums.why: The Mood Hut co-founder's long-awaited album is sung, soft-focus Vancouver house; lo-fi's gentlest, most domestic record.

albums.title: What I Breathe
albums.why: Jordon Alexander's debut album leaves lo-fi house behind for breakbeat, trance and guest rappers; a mixed record from the scene's biggest DJ.

note: The lo-fi wave itself produced few albums, so this shelf opens with the Detroit and Dutch records it sampled its sound from.
